title: Dabo Swinney's recent complaints about college football bolster the case for a CBA

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dabo Swinney's recent complaints about college football bolster the case for a CBA
sources.description: The ongoing push for a federal law that restores the NCAA's roar conveniently overlooks a solution that college football (and other revenue sports) should be pursuing on their own.
